purpose: classification replay of the saved attacks through candidate selection rules; no attack is re-optimised
caveat: the patches were optimised against base, so every other defence is measured under transfer, not against an adapted attacker; the oracle arms additionally use the true patch location, which no deployable defence has, so they are an optimistic reference and not a ceiling
indexing: clean_ok and correct are positions in the development draw; fixed_images and broken_images are dataset indices
